etymology: Phono-semantic: patrol routes (行) + 韋 'circling feet' (phonetic エイ) — sentries circling the walls: to guard.
mnemonic: Feet tracing the ramparts all night — エイ. 衛星: the satellite, patrolling the planet.

etymology: Compound ideograph: water brimming over the dish (皿) — overflow: gain, benefit (the origin of 溢).
mnemonic: The bowl running over — エキ. 利益: the overflow, booked as profit.

etymology: Phono-semantic: step (彳) + 主 (phonetic オウ) — setting out: to go (as opposed to 復, returning).
mnemonic: Outbound leg of the round trip — オウ. 往復: there and back, ticketed together.

etymology: Phono-semantic: a frame-pole phonetic (カン) — the load-bearing shaft: trunk, mainstay; the capable one (幹事).
mnemonic: The pole everything else hangs from — みき. 新幹線: the trunk line of the whole country.

etymology: Phono-semantic: eye (目) + 艮 (phonetic ガン) — the eye as organ: eyeball; the discerning eye (眼力).
mnemonic: 目's clinical cousin — ガン. 眼科: where eyeballs file complaints; 眼鏡: their crutches.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 己 (phonetic キ) — events strung in order: chronicle, era.
mnemonic: History on a single thread — キ. 世紀: the thread cut in hundred-year lengths.

etymology: Compound: the offering sheep (羊) over the self (我) — the self made presentable: duty, righteousness; by extension 'in-law', 'artificial'.
mnemonic: The ego dressed in sacrificial wool — ギ. 正義 and 義理: justice, and its social installment plan.

etymology: Compound ideograph: hands on all sides lifting together — raising up: to flourish, revive; raised spirits: interest, fun.
mnemonic: Everyone lifts and the mood rises with it — キョウ, おこす. 興味: the mind lifting toward something.

etymology: Compound ideograph: speech (口) wrapped in a hook (勹) — a bounded unit of language: phrase, verse.
mnemonic: Words tied off in a parcel — ク. 俳句: seventeen syllables, triple-wrapped.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 絜 (phonetic ケツ) — washed and bound clean: pure.
mnemonic: Scrubbed until even the knots gleam — いさぎよい. 清潔: hygiene as a virtue.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 蒦 (phonetic ゴ) — speaking for and shielding: to protect.
mnemonic: Advocacy with its arms out — ゴ. 看護, 弁護: nurses and lawyers, same kanji shield.

etymology: Compound ideograph: flood (巛) over fire (火) — the two classic ruins in one character: calamity.
mnemonic: Water above, fire below: pick your catastrophe — わざわい. 災害: the news ticker's kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 櫻): tree (木) + a phonetic — the blossom tree of Japan: the cherry.
mnemonic: The tree the whole country picnics under — さくら. 桜前線: the pink weather front.

etymology: Phono-semantic: fermentation jar (酉) + 夋 (phonetic サン) — the brew gone sharp: sour, acid.
mnemonic: The jar that turned — サン. 酸素: oxygen, chemistry's sour salt namesake.

etymology: Pictograph: read as a small ceremonial axe or an upright figure — the man of service: warrior, scholar, licensed professional (弁護士).
mnemonic: Shoulders broader than the feet: the standing officer — シ. 武士 then, 消防士 now.

etymology: Phono-semantic: food (飠) + 司 (phonetic シ) — feeding on schedule: to keep animals.
mnemonic: Whoever manages the food bowl rules the species — かう. 飼い主: the bowl administrator.

etymology: Pictograph: a simple roofed building — lodgings: quarters, a hut.
mnemonic: Plain roof, plain walls, beds inside — シャ. 田舎: cottage country; 駅舎: the station's own hut.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 射 (phonetic シャ) — words released like an arrow: to apologize, to thank, to decline.
mnemonic: The sentence you loose and can't take back — あやまる. 感謝: the grateful arrow.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hall (广) + 予 (phonetic ジョ) — the anteroom before the main hall: preface, sequence.
mnemonic: The lobby of the book — ジョ. 順序: lobby, hallway, room — in order.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 正 (phonetic ショウ) — testimony that squares with fact: proof, certificate.
mnemonic: Words that survive cross-examination — ショウ. 学生証, 証拠: laminated and legal proof.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 戠 (phonetic ショク) — threads crossed on the loom: to weave.
mnemonic: Warp meets weft, cloth happens — おる. 組織: society on the same loom.

etymology: Compound: raw undyed silk (糸) — the base state: plain, element, bare (素手).
mnemonic: Thread before the dye vat — ソ, ス. 素晴らしい: plainness, somehow, become splendid.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 屬): attached under (尸) — fastened to: to belong, be attached.
mnemonic: Pinned to the organization chart — ゾク. 所属: your box on the diagram.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 能 (phonetic タイ) + heart (心) — the bearing the heart gives the body: condition, attitude.
mnemonic: What the bear-heart looks like from outside — タイ. 態度: posture with opinions.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 是 (phonetic テイ) — held out in the hand: to present, propose.
mnemonic: Offered at arm's length for inspection — テイ. 提案: the held-out idea.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 充 (phonetic トウ) — all threads gathered to one end: to unify, govern.
mnemonic: Every strand pulled through one ring — トウ. 伝統 and 大統領: the long thread and its holder.

etymology: Compound: flesh (月) filled out — to fatten; what fattens the soil: fertilizer.
mnemonic: Rich flesh, rich earth — こえる. 肥料: the field's dinner.

etymology: Simplification merging three old characters (辯 speech, 瓣 petal/valve, 辨 discriminate) — hence its odd jobs: speech, valve, lunchbox (弁当), dialect.
mnemonic: One kanji, many part-time jobs — ベン. 弁護士 argues; 弁当 feeds; 関西弁 talks back.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 莫 'sun lost in grass' (phonetic ボ) + earth (土) — the plot where the sun goes down: a grave.
mnemonic: Earth, grass, and a name — はか. お墓参り: visiting the quiet address.

etymology: Compound: flesh (月) + branching water — the body's rivers: veins, the pulse; mountain chains (山脈).
mnemonic: Rivers under the skin, drumming — ミャク. 脈がある: a pulse — and a chance.

etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 貴 (phonetic イ) — the precious thing left on the road behind: to leave, bequeath.
mnemonic: What stays when the traveler goes on — イ. 遺産: the suitcase left to you; 世界遺産: left to everyone.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 㕣 (phonetic エン) — following the water's edge: along.
mnemonic: The path that copies the river — そう. 沿線: everything strung along the train line.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 因 'what one rests on' (phonetic オン) + heart (心) — the kindness one's heart rests on: obligation-laden grace.
mnemonic: The favor that became part of your foundations — オン. 恩人: the person your heart still leans on.

etymology: Pictograph: a toothed halberd, borrowed since the oracle bones for the first person: I, the self.
mnemonic: The self, drawn as a weapon — われ. 我々: two blades walking together.

etymology: Phono-semantic: gate (門) + 各 (phonetic カク) — the high pavilion above the gate: tower; the ministers gathered there: cabinet.
mnemonic: The gilded upper room — カク. 金閣寺 shines; 内閣 governs.

etymology: Phono-semantic: tree (木) + 朱 (phonetic シュ) — the stump that stays and sprouts: a stump; the standing share of an enterprise: stock.
mnemonic: The stump that keeps paying shoots — かぶ. 株式会社: a forest of stumps, incorporated.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 軍 (phonetic キ) — the hand that signals the army: to wave, wield, conduct.
mnemonic: One raised hand moves the whole formation — キ. 指揮者: the conductor's entire job description.

etymology: Compound: goods lifted in both hands over treasure (貝) — held high: precious, noble; honorific 'your' (貴社).
mnemonic: Held above the money it outranks — とうとい. 貴重品: the hotel-safe kanji.

etymology: Pictograph origin: two people facing each other over a shared dish — the community that eats together: home village.
mnemonic: Dinner facing familiar faces — きょう, ゴウ. 故郷: the table you grew up at.

etymology: Compound: fibers like bamboo (⺮) in the flesh (月) with strength (力) — sinew, muscle; the fiber of an argument: the plot, the logic.
mnemonic: Bamboo-fiber cables under the skin — すじ. 筋肉 lifts; 筋が通る: the plot holds.

etymology: Compound ideograph: a hand holding threads together — the connected line: lineage, system.
mnemonic: One thread pinched at the top, everything hangs from it — ケイ. 文系・理系: which thread you hang from at 18.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 敫 (phonetic ゲキ) — water dashing on rock: violent, intense.
mnemonic: The rapids section of any emotion — はげしい. 激安, 激辛: intensity as marketing.

etymology: Pictograph: the mouth of a dwelling-cave — a hole; the radical of all excavations (空, 究, 窓).
mnemonic: The cave door our ancestors called home — あな. 穴場: the hole worth knowing about.

etymology: Compound: the standard displayed under the roof, watched by eye and heart — the fundamental law: constitution.
mnemonic: The rules above even the rulers — ケン. 憲法: the roof over the law.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 肙 (phonetic ケン) — the worm's thread: silk.
mnemonic: The worm's lifework, unwound — きぬ. 絹の道: the Silk Road, literally.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 嚴): a craggy cliff phonetic — forbidding as a rock face: strict, severe, solemn.
mnemonic: The cliff face of authority — きびしい. 厳しい先生: geology in human form.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 原 'spring at the cliff' (phonetic ゲン) — 原 restored to its waters: the source.
mnemonic: 原 with the water switched back on — みなもと. 資源, 電源: sources you drill and sources you plug.

etymology: Pictograph: a coiled cord — borrowed since antiquity for the self: I, oneself.
mnemonic: The line that loops back to its own start — おのれ. 自己: the self, squared.
